description: Phase 14: visual contradiction. Caption above the image reads 'Three blue squares.' but the picture below contains TWO RED CIRCLES. A correct answer must call out the actual picture content — red circles, count of two — rather than agreeing with the caption.

questions.question: The caption at the top says 'Three blue squares.' Look at the actual picture below the caption and describe what is really there. Mention colour, shape, and count.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for caption-vs-picture contradiction detection. Pass requires the model to describe the actual picture content (red + circle + two) rather than echo the caption (blue/squares/three).

known_scoring_limitations: text_match_all requires ALL of red + circle + two to appear. The 240-char cap leaves room for short prose like 'Two red circles. The caption is wrong.' but not for a both-sides essay that lists every word in both halves.
